en.alarmHelp.title: Alarm Troubleshooting
en.alarmHelp.intro: The app is tested on many phones. It should work without issues. However, if your alarm did not sound as expected, your device's system settings might be blocking it. Please check the following:
en.alarmHelp.notifications.desc: Make sure notifications are fully enabled for this app. The alarm cannot wake up your screen without permission.
en.alarmHelp.battery.desc: Go to your phone's Settings > Apps > Battery, and set this app to 'Unrestricted' or 'Not Optimized'. Otherwise, the system might kill the alarm to save battery.
en.alarmHelp.background.desc: Ensure the app has permission to run in the background so it can trigger the alarm at the exact time you set.
en.alarmHelp.volume.desc: Double-check that your device's Alarm Volume is turned up and that 'Do Not Disturb' allows alarms to sound.
en.alarmHelp.battery.optimized.desc: Alarms may be blocked. Disable battery optimization to ensure reliable alarms.
en.alarmHelp.battery.unrestricted.desc: The app can run freely in the background.
en.alarmHelp.intro.ios: The app is tested on many devices. It should work without issues. However, if your alarm did not sound, iOS system settings may be blocking it. Please check the following:
en.alarmHelp.focus.desc: Go to Settings > Focus (or Do Not Disturb) and make sure this app is allowed to send notifications, or turn Focus off during meditation.
en.alarmHelp.notifications.ios.desc: Go to Settings > ekaTimer > Notifications and make sure 'Allow Notifications' is on, with Sounds enabled.
en.alarmHelp.backgroundRefresh.desc: Go to Settings > General > Background App Refresh and enable it for ekaTimer. This lets the app stay active when your screen is off.
en.alarmHelp.volume.ios.desc: Make sure your device is not on Silent (check the physical ring/silent switch on the side). Also check that the volume is turned up in Settings > Sounds.
en.home.batteryWarning.title: Turn off screen during meditation?
en.home.batteryWarning.desc: To ensure your timer rings reliably when your screen is off, please allow the app to run in the background.

de.alarmHelp.title: Wecker-Fehlerbehebung
de.alarmHelp.intro: Wenn der Wecker nicht klingelt, blockiert möglicherweise das System. Bitte überprüfen:
de.alarmHelp.notifications.desc: Stelle sicher, dass Benachrichtigungen aktiviert sind, damit der Wecker den Bildschirm wecken kann.
de.alarmHelp.battery.desc: Gehe zu Einstellungen > Apps > Akku und setze die App auf 'Nicht optimiert'.
de.alarmHelp.background.desc: Erlaube der App, im Hintergrund zu laufen, um den Wecker pünktlich auszulösen.
de.alarmHelp.volume.desc: Stelle sicher, dass die Weckerlautstärke an ist und 'Bitte nicht stören' Wecker zulässt.

de.alarmHelp.battery.unrestricted.desc: Die App kann frei im Hintergrund laufen.
de.alarmHelp.intro.ios: Wenn der Wecker nicht klingelt, blockieren möglicherweise iOS-Einstellungen. Bitte überprüfen:
de.alarmHelp.focus.desc: Gehe zu Einstellungen > Fokus und erlaube dieser App Benachrichtigungen oder deaktiviere den Fokus.
de.alarmHelp.notifications.ios.desc: Gehe zu Einstellungen > ekaTimer > Benachrichtigungen und aktiviere 'Benachrichtigungen zulassen' mit Tönen.
de.alarmHelp.backgroundRefresh.desc: Gehe zu Einstellungen > Allgemein > Hintergrundaktualisierung und aktiviere sie für ekaTimer.
de.alarmHelp.volume.ios.desc: Stelle sicher, dass das Gerät nicht auf Lautlos steht. Prüfe auch die Lautstärke unter Einstellungen > Töne.

ne.alarmHelp.backgroundRefresh.desc: सेटिङ्हरू > सामान्य > ब्याकग्राउन्ड एप रिफ्रेस मा जानुहोस् र ekaTimer को लागि सक्षम गर्नुहोस्।

ne.editPresets.title: प्रिसेट अवधि सम्पादन गर्नुहोस्
ne.editPresets.desc: ४ निश्चित घण्टा बटनहरूको लागि मान सेट गर्नुहोस् (मिनेटमा):
